## Rates

Lodging is reimbursed at the published rate.  
Meals follow the daily allowance.

| Code | Expense category | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | Lodging | 180 |
| M1 | Meals | 64 |

- Before travel
  - Request approval
  - Book through the travel desk
- After travel

  Submit receipts within sixty days.
